title: Microsoft Azure Cloud Architect for AI
description:
We are seeking an experienced Microsoft Azure Cloud Architect to design and implement a secure, cloud-based working environment for remote contractors and autonomous AI agents. The goal is to centralize company operations in the cloud, reduce reliance on personal devices, and enable AI agents to operate independently 24/7. The ideal freelancer will help build a scalable, secure infrastructure that supports remote collaboration, automated workflows, and reliable long-term system performance.

Scope of Work
Windows 365 Cloud PCs: Configure dedicated virtual desktops for approximately 4 remote contractors, with secure logins, restricted file transfers, and centrally managed applications.
Microsoft Azure: Set up secure cloud infrastructure to host autonomous AI agents using Azure Container Apps, Functions, and virtual machines only where necessary.
AI Agent Infrastructure: Enable 24/7 AI workflows using Claude, OpenAI, and other agent platforms, with persistent job tracking and automatic recovery.
MCP & API Integrations: Establish secure connectivity to applications including Google Ads, Meta, GoHighLevel (GHL), Slack, WordPress, and other business platforms.
SharePoint: Configure centralized company file storage, SOPs, knowledge bases, and controlled access for employees and AI agents.
Security: Implement Microsoft Entra ID, Intune, MFA, Conditional Access, access restrictions, monitoring, and data protection.
Automation: Establish the infrastructure for AI agents to execute scheduled tasks, share information, and request human approval when necessary.

Required Experience
Microsoft Azure architecture and deployment
Windows 365 Enterprise, Intune, and Entra ID
Azure Container Apps, Functions, and virtual machines
AI agent hosting, MCP servers, and API integrations
SharePoint and Microsoft Graph API
Enterprise cloud security and remote workforce management

Expected Deliverables
A fully configured, secure, documented cloud environment with working contractor desktops, operational AI agent infrastructure, and a scalable architecture.

Important: Contractors must perform company work within their assigned Windows 365 Cloud PCs, with technical restrictions on direct access from personal devices wherever supported.
